digest.component_or_area: LLM fallback model instrumentation and tracing
propositions: Each attempted fallback candidate must emit exactly one OTel span with zero-based order, provider-qualified model identity, and outcome from {returned, raised}, nesting under the Agent model-request span without duplication from instrument_all.
Candidate span reasons for raised outcomes must be sanitized via sanitize_diagnostic with no exposure of prompts, responses, credentials, endpoints, or unsanitized error bodies.
The existing FallbackExceptionGroup ordering and the S2-preserved bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade must remain unchanged; instrumentation observes but does not alter the control flow.
Span emission or exporter failures while tracing is enabled must be swallowed, leaving fallback result, RunUsage, and propagated exceptions identical to tracing-off.

Provider-reported usage must be recorded on candidate spans when the SDK response exposes it; RunUsage and usage JSONL must not include candidate counters and must be identical with tracing on and off.
A lean base install without tracing extra imports must run with no span dependency error, and tracing disabled must produce identical result and exception behavior.
